data.name: Alzahra
data.gender_notes: Alzahra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'zahra', meaning 'to bloom' or 'to flourish'. Alzahra symbolizes the growth and development of a person, particularly in their spiritual journey. The name Alzahra carries the meaning “The Flowering One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alzahra usually hope their child will grow to embody the flowering one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name deeply rooted in Islamic tradition, evoking images of the Garden of Paradise and the blossoming of faith.
data.etymology: Alzahra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Flowering One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alzahra total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الزهراء
in_arabic.meaning: الزهراء تعني الزهرة أو الوردة البيضاء الجميلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الزهراء هو اسم علم مؤنث يطلق على الفتيات في الثقافة الإسلامية، مشتق من الجذر العربي 'زهر' الذي يعني 'الزهر' أو 'الورد'. الزهراء هي الزهرة أو الوردة البيضاء الجميلة، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالجمال والنور. في القرآن الكريم، يوصف النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم بـ 'الزهراء' كونه النور الذي أضاء للإنسانية. يستخدم الاسم كدلالة على الجمال الروحي والخُلقي.

in_urdu.name: الزہراء
in_urdu.meaning: الزہراء کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت زہرہ یا سفید گل
in_urdu.long_meaning: الزہراء ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو اسلامی ثقافت میں لڑکیوں کو دیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ عربی جڑ 'زهر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'زہر' یا 'گل'۔ الزہراء خوبصورت زہرہ یا سفید گل کے معنی ہے، اور عموماً جمال اور نور سے وابستہ ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام اہل بیت النبی، خاص طور پر فاطمہ الزہراء، بنت رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم، کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अल्ज़हरा
in_hindi.meaning: अल्ज़हरा का अर्थ है सुंदर फूल या सफेद गुलाब
in_hindi.long_meaning: अल्ज़हरा इस्लामी संस्कृति में लड़कियों को दिया जाने वाला एक सुंदर नाम है। यह अरबी मूल 'زهر' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'फूल' या 'गुलाब'। अल्ज़हरा का अर्थ है सुंदर फूल या सफेद गुलाब, जो अक्सर सौंदर्य और प्रकाश से जुड़ा होता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम फातिमा अल-ज़हरा, पैगंबर मुहम्मद की बेटी, से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: الزهرا
in_pashto.meaning: الزهرا د ښکل زهره يا سپين ګل معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: الزهرا د ښځو یو نوم دی چې په اسلامي کلتور کې کارول کیږي. دا د عربي ريښې 'زهر' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې 'زهره' يا 'ګل' دی. الزهرا د ښکل زهره يا سپين ګل معنی لري، او ډیری وختونه د ښکلا او رڼا سره تړاو لري. دا نوم د فاطمې الزهرا، د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم د لور، سره نږدې دی.

in_english.name: Alzahra
in_english.meaning: Alzahra means beautiful flower or white rose in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Alzahra is a feminine given name in Islamic culture, derived from the Arabic root 'زهر' (z-h-r), meaning 'flower' or 'blossom'. It signifies beauty, elegance, and spiritual illumination. In Islamic tradition, Alzahra is associated with Fatimah al-Zahra, the daughter of Prophet Muhammad. The name symbolizes purity, wisdom, and the blossoming of spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alzahra holds significant cultural importance, particularly in the Shia Muslim community. Alzahra is the name of a legendary figure in Shia tradition known as "Lady Fatima Alzahra", the fourth daughter of Prophet Muhammad SAW and his beloved wife Aisha. She is highly revered and known for her impeccable character, purity, and intelligence. This name signifies growth, prosperity, and inspiration to generations of Shia Muslims, who believe the name to be a source of strength and hope.
data.spiritual_significance: For spiritual significance, Alzahra symbolizes the radiant beauty, resilience, and spiritual growth that a person can achieve through their journey of faith. It represents the divine assistance and guidance of God (Allah) and the importance of continuous effort and development towards a righteous and fulfilling life. In the prophetic sunnah, there is the famous du'aa for Alzahra (peace be upon her): "O Allah, make Al-Zahra [Fatimah] a source of guidance, support, and comfort for us. Amen". Our quest towards this spiritual image embodied by Alzahra propels us to strive for inner growth, knowledge, wisdom, and submission to Allah.
